subject: Multi-cloud MAP orientation: Marketplace listing and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Stevens <amy.stevens@cloudmarketplace.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, GCP Partner Onboarding <partner-gcp@partnerco.com>, Azure ISV Programs <isv-azure@azurepartners.net>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-30T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Multi-cloud MAP orientation: Marketplace listing and evaluation plan

Hi Amy + Marketplace teams,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the MAP for StratusCloud — excited to get the listing and evaluation plan moving across AWS, GCP, and Azure. High-level goals for this MAP:
- Complete marketplace listing metadata & images by 2027-01-20
- Finish security/compliance evidence collection (SOC2 excerpts, data flow diagram) by 2027-01-10
- Run a short engineering evaluation with StratusCloud (10 perf/accuracy tests) by 2027-01-28
- Target close/acceptance no later than 2027-02-10

I've attached a draft MAP spreadsheet that breaks down milestones and owners (Attachment: multi-cloud-MAP-draft.xlsx). Please review the owner assignments in the first tab; we intentionally split tasks by cloud owner to avoid duplication.

Immediate asks:
1) Amy — can you confirm who at StratusCloud will own the evaluation sign-off and availability windows?
2) AWS/GCP/Azure ops — please confirm any additional submission requirements or partner forms we should add to the MAP checklist (I attached reqs-marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf).
3) Vanessa/Ben — can you own coordinating the engineering eval and documenting test cases?

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync next week to align on milestones and cutover dates.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: multi-cloud-MAP-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
Attachment: reqs-marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Amy Stevens <amy.stevens@cloudmarketplace.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, GCP Partner Onboarding <partner-gcp@partnerco.com>, Azure ISV Programs <isv-azure@azurepartners.net>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-31T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud MAP orientation: Marketplace listing and evaluation plan

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments, this looks good. Quick answers:
- StratusCloud PM owning evaluation sign-off is Maya Lopez (maya.lopez@stratuscloud.com). She's available for a kickoff week of 2027-01-03 (limited) and more fully 2027-01-10 onwards.
- For AWS: marketplace team needs the security summary + AMI/container scan report during submission. I tagged AWS Ops on this thread.
- For GCP: we need the service account onboarding doc and a short integration test plan.
- For Azure: please include a short privacy & data residency statement if you expect EU/UK regions to be used.

I'll join the sync next week. If it helps, my team can host the MAP doc in a shared Drive and surface any missing fields.

Best,
Amy
Amy Stevens
Marketplace Program Manager
Attachment: maya-lopez-contact.vcf (vCard, 1KB)

From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Amy Stevens <amy.stevens@cloudmarketplace.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-03T08:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud MAP orientation: Marketplace listing and evaluation plan

Hi all —

From AWS ops side, please confirm the following before we accept the listing submission:
- Artifact: architecture diagram (PDF) with network boundaries and data flow
- Artifact: AMI/container scan report or SBOM for the binary image
- Billing designation: paid listing vs. free trial (we need the SKU and pricing matrix)
- Testing: we can run a staging acceptance check the week of 2027-01-24 (1 day).

If Redwood can upload the architecture diagram and SBOM to the DocShare link (or provide a signed URL) by 2027-01-10 we can keep to your timeline.

Thanks,
AWS Marketplace Ops
Attachment: aws-submission-guidelines.pdf (PDF, 56KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Amy Stevens <amy.stevens@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: 2027-01-06T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud MAP orientation: Marketplace listing and evaluation plan

Thanks for the updates. Per Nikhil's ask, Ben and I will drive the engineering evaluation. Plan:
- Week of 2027-01-10: finalize test cases and environment access (Ben to coordinate with StratusCloud infra)
- 2027-01-17 to 2027-01-20: run perf and accuracy tests (5 canonical prompts, 3 load scenarios)
- 2027-01-24: handoff to marketplace staging acceptance (AWS noted they can do this week)

Action items assigned in the MAP spreadsheet (see related link): Ben — reach out to maya.lopez@stratuscloud.com to request test credentials and sample dataset. I'll prepare a short runbook for the evaluation so AWS/GCP/Azure teams can replicate.

Ben: can you confirm availability for 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-20 window?

Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: evaluation-test-cases.md (Markdown, 8KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Amy Stevens <amy.stevens@cloudmarketplace.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-12T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud MAP orientation: Marketplace listing and evaluation plan

All — quick update: I locked test windows with StratusCloud (Maya) for 2027-01-17 and 2027-01-19 for two 3-hour sessions. StratusCloud will provide a service account and a 10K-record sample dataset by 2027-01-14.

I'll upload the runbook and test harness to the MAP sheet and flag any infra blockers by EOD 2027-01-14. If any marketplace ops teams need early access to staging endpoints, ping me and I'll share temporary creds.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: runbook-test-harness.tar.gz (archive, 2.1MB)
